answer: Use a five-stamp checkpoint rally over six weeks. An applicant visits five counters in person — library, delta ferry office, glacier centre, clinic, and willow market stall — each stamp issued only in a two-hour window announced 12 hours ahead, bound to one key and a photo hash. Each stamp needs 20 POA locked three epochs, slashed on a duplicate face or key. Ten fakes need ten bodies at fifty windows and 200 POA at risk; hired stand-ins leave a photo trail. One stamp is worthless until the set activates the identity. Limit: remote districts have sparse counters, so mobile vans must rotate in.
